item.title: CoDaPack
item.description: CoDaPack provides data management, statistical analysis, and graphical tools for compositional data through a stand-alone interface. It is available for Windows and macOS, with source code released openly.

item.title: coda.base
item.description: coda.base provides a compact set of functions for compositional data analysis, including log-ratio coordinates, bases, transformations, descriptive methods, and supporting datasets. Performance-critical functions are implemented in C++.

item.title: coda.plot
item.description: coda.plot complements coda.base with graphical methods designed for exploring and presenting compositional data and their log-ratio representations.

item.title: coda.pack
item.description: coda.pack attaches the stable coda.base and coda.plot packages and provides helper functions for discovering, installing, and updating packages in the coda ecosystem.

item.title: coda.count
item.description: coda.count extends the coda ecosystem with methods for compositional count data. It is currently under development and is available from GitHub.
